PSTC Lab Report

Week 1

Title: Week 1 programming practice. Basic programming

Aim:

To understand and implement the basic concept of c programming using variables, data types, input/output functions, operators, conditional statements, switch statements, and simple problem-solving techniques.

Objective:

→ learn the use of variables and different data types.

→ perform arithmetic, relational and logical operations.

→ Implement decision-making using if-else and nested if-statement.

→ use switch statements for menu-driven programs.

Program I had worked through this lab.

1. Level-1

In this level-1, I had worked on the basic programs of e language. i.e. Ever or odd programs, positive, negative or zero, character type.

Identification: Leap year program, By these programs we can understand the language in the better way.

---

<!-- Page 2 -->

### a. level-2 level-2

→ In this level, performs arithmetic operations based on the user's menu choice using a'switch', Statement, Swaps two numbers, using arithmetic operations without an extra variable. Swap using temporary variable, perfect square, student grade.

3. level-3

In this level, we look at the understanding of these programs in the Menu program with error handling. Largest among three numbers, Grade point to letter grade.

## Learning outcomes

→ understood the syntax and structure of c programs

) Learned to solve simple logical problems using conditional statements.

→ Gained experience with arithmetic and logical operators.

Developed confidence in writing and testing a program.

## Conclusion:

The week1 programming practice helped in building a strong foundation in c programming. The programs understanding of basic programming concepts, logical thinking and problem-solving skills which are essential.
